facts.text: I am planning to host a garden party soon.
I want to calculate the area of my raised bed.
I noticed the first sprouts emerging on March 5th.
My raised bed is 4 feet by 8 feet.
My raised bed is about 3 feet high.
I am planning to invite around 10-12 guests.
I am thinking of serving garden-fresh appetizers and drinks at the party.
I am thinking of setting up a small herb station where guests can make their own herb-infused drinks.
I am thinking of setting up a few stations for guests to take photos with my garden as the backdrop.
